commitResults.messageTitle: Add model foundation for roles and guardian links
Harden guardian links and address PR review comments
commitResults.messageBody:
A guardian link could previously be attached to any contact, letting
invalid states (guardian-with-guardian, self-links) into the model.
Enforce both rules in the Person constructor so every creation path is
covered; target-role validation needs both contacts and stays with the
link command and storage load.

Also, as raised in review:
- Rename withGuardian to withGuardianId to match what it accepts
- Reword Person#equals javadoc to state the id is excluded and why
- Give the sample guardian a fixed UUID so repeated sample-data
  generations produce equal data
- Add tests: edit preserves id/role/guardianId, link guards throw,
  sample data roles and linked pair, hashCode consistency
Add model foundation for roles and guardian links

commitResults.messageTitle: Add role filter to list command
commitResults.messageBody:
`list` previously showed every contact with no way to narrow a long
mixed list. Support `list r/ROLE` to show only students or only
guardians; bare `list` still clears the filter. Extraneous preamble
arguments are now rejected instead of silently ignored, and the UG's
claim that `list` ignores extra parameters is removed to match.

commitResults.messageBody: Update the use cases, NFR, and glossary sections (MZ)

Currently JsonAdaptedPerson does not store the role and uuid,
which results in the default role being STUDENT, and
IDs being regenerated on load. Guardian links are also unable
to survive a restart.

Updating the Person and JsonAdaptedPerson class with those
fields allows the possibility of a properly working
local automatic storage, where student-guardian links are
preserved along with IDs when saved in local storage.
